summary_en: Tender price raised to ¥3,450/share from ¥3,000; tender period extended from 2026-07-22 to 2026-08-03 (58 business days). Self-tender offer price set at ¥2,805/share. Delisting objective. Board endorsement and shareholder discretion remain unchanged. Warrant prices set at ¥1 each across 11 classes.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to "Announcement of Endorsement and Recommendation of Tender Offer for Company Shares by Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd."
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-17, Kakaku.com disclosed an amendment to its MBO disclosure regarding the tender offer by Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd. (a consortium vehicle backed by Bain Capital Private Equity LP and LINE Yahoo Corporation). The tender price for ordinary shares has been raised to ¥3,450 per share from the previously announced ¥3,000 per share. The tender period has been extended from the originally scheduled end date of 2026-07-22 to 2026-08-03, making the total tender period 58 business days (previously 50 business days). The self-tender offer price for treasury shares has been set at ¥2,805 per share. Warrants across 11 classes (8th through 20th series of stock acquisition rights) will be acquired at ¥1 per warrant. The objective remains delisting and privatization (非公開化). The board's endorsement stance and shareholders' voluntary participation remain unchanged. The price increase reflects the offerors' consideration of the competing proposal from Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo (¥3,384/share), market conditions, and subscription trends.
